extraction_boundary: WP-007 cycle 2 extracts candidate requirements from exactly one named historical source, HS-011, the ULW-AS-001 v1.3 accessibility acceptance contract as carried in this repository at docs/ACCESSIBILITY_ACCEPTANCE.md, bound to commit 6e447103fcb65c2054d2080a12847777960a4642. Every normative sentence and every table row of that document is extracted; nothing outside that file is read, and no second source is opened. Candidates are pre-disposition records: no owner disposition, no conformance state, and no implementation, testing, release, or claimability meaning is attached to any record. WP-007 cycle 4 adds exactly one further source under DEC-019: HS-023, Section 11 of the digest-verified historical August 5, 2026 v0.2.0 clean-room rewrite PDF, printed pages 20-21. Every normative statement on those two pages is extracted and nothing outside Section 11 of that document is read as an extraction surface. Candidates from the two sources are kept separate; they are related in data/historical/restatement-index.json and are never merged, deduplicated, or ranked.
source_selection_rationale: The owner named a verified August 5, 2026 clean-room v0.2 source as preferred if genuinely reachable. It is not reachable through the repository's governed source mechanism: the only clean-room packages recorded anywhere in the repository are the v0.15-v0.23 Drive ZIPs listed in docs/wp-006/DRIVE_REPOSITORY_AUTHORITY_MAP.md line 39, which are held under HS-018/HS-019, carry access_limitation NOT-ACCESSIBLE-TO-EXECUTOR and version_or_hash NOT-AVAILABLE, and whose import is recorded as prohibited. No repository artifact dated August 5, 2026 or versioned v0.2 exists as a requirement source, so no such source was opened, inferred, or simulated. The next highest-authority reachable HIGH-relevance source was selected: HS-011. Among reachable HIGH sources, HS-003 and HS-011 are both HISTORICAL-EVIDENCE while HS-006 is RESEARCH-INPUT and HS-005 is REFERENCE-ONLY; of the two HISTORICAL-EVIDENCE sources, HS-003 is a current-state report about the repository, whereas HS-011 is the only reachable source that carries adopted-standard normative requirement wording, which is the material this cycle exists to recover. HS-011 is recorded PARTIAL because only the repository-carried excerpt is reachable; that limitation is inherited by every record and no claim is made about the upstream full standard. Cycle 4 supersedes the reachability limitation recorded above for this one artifact only: the owner supplied the historical August 5 v0.2.0 PDF, workbook, and manifest on 2026-08-19, each measured digest matched the value DEC-019 declares, and DEC-019 names Section 11 of the PDF as the authorized extraction surface. The historical v0.2.0 DOCX and ZIP were still not supplied and remain unread.
